Simple, clean lines and beautiful quarter-sawn oak veneer finish make this piece look at home in rustic or modern settings. 78"L x 40"D x 30"H Hardwood table top with quarter-sawn oak veneer and metal base A simple modern piece with rustic and industrial influences Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
